officialEvidence.finding: Official Pune Division recruitment page names one contractual Legal Officer advertisement, dated 1 August 2026, and links the scanned PDF.

Twelve-page scanned Marathi notice, decision and form. Page 1 says one 11-month contract, application receipt by 31 August 2026 during office hours, recognised law degree, Bar Council membership, seven years' practice, age not above 45 at appointment, and adequate Marathi/Hindi/English knowledge. It states ₹45,000 honorarium plus ₹5,000 fixed allowance per month.

internationalApplicantAssessment: No nationality or foreign-citizen rule was identified on checked notice page 1. Application and eventual contract eligibility remain needs-verification for all nationalities; do not infer permission from silence.
languageAssessment: Adequate knowledge of Marathi, Hindi and English is explicitly requested. No formal level, certificate or test score is printed on checked page 1.
datePrecision: 31 August 2026 is application receipt date. No opening date, exact hour or official timezone is printed. Do not convert office hours to an invented cutoff time.
venueAssessment: Pune Vidhan Bhavan is stated work and application-receipt location, not an interview venue. No selection pin created.
access: Pune host robots.txt returned HTTP 200 text/plain and only restricted wp-admin. Linked cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in robots.txt returned HTTP 404; public PDF responded with exact bytes.
coverageLimit: One closed Pune Division advertisement only; later amendments, remaining Pune Division notices, Maharashtra PSC and other Maharashtra authorities remain gaps.
reviewNeeds: Founder checks scanned Marathi translation, full eligibility and forms, any later amendments, application submission method and foreign-citizen appointment rules before approval.
